examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, akusalamūlāni. katamāni tīṇi? lobho akusalamūlaṃ, doso akusalamūlaṃ, moho akusalamūlaṃ
piyā su lokasmiṃ kutonidānā, ye vā'pi lobhā vicaranti loke, āsā ca niṭṭhā ca kutonidānā, ye samparāyāya narassa honti.

so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti

56102.meaning1: wearing away of greed; exhaustion of desire
56102.commentary: (ANa) so lobhakkhayāyā'ti iminā'pi anāgāmino bhavalobhakkhay'atthāya arahattamaggavipassanā'va kathitā.

examples.text: so taṇhākkhayāya paṭipanno hoti. so lobhakkhayāya paṭipanno hoti. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.

56103.meaning1: born from greed; arisen from desire

examples.text: ye kho te, bhaddiya, loke santo sappurisā te sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti, ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, lobhaṃ vineyya viharāhi. lobhaṃ vineyya viharanto na lobhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā.

56104.meaning2: greed and hatred; desire and ill-will

56105.meaning1: state of desire; characteristic of greed
56105.commentary: (MNa) lobhadhammā'ti lobhasaṅkhātā dhammā, nānappakārakaṃ lobhaṃ'y'eva sandhāya vadati. itaresu'pi dvīsu es'eva nayo.

examples.text: sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho uccākulīnatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, kosu nāma me dhammo ajjhattaṃ appahīno yena me ekadā lobhadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, dosadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, mohadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhantī'ti.

56106.meaning1: originating from greed; with desire as source

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati.

atthi nu kho imass'āyasmato tathārūpā lobhanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi lobhanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya, jānāmī'ti, apassaṃ vā vadeyya, passāmī'ti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti?

56109.meaning1: created by greed; produced by desire
56109.commentary: (ANa) lobhapakatan'ti lobhena pakataṃ, lobh'ābhibhūtena luddhena hutvā katakamman'ti attho.

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati.

56110.meaning1: dependent on greed; due to desire

examples.text: iti'ssa'me lobhajā lobhanidānā lobhasamudayā lobhapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti.

56114.meaning1: with greed as source; originating from desire
56114.commentary: (ANa) lobho samudayo assā'ti lobhasamudayaṃ. samudayo'ti paccayo, lobhapaccayan'ti attho.

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati.
alobh'ādayo lobh'ādi-paṭipakkha-vasena veditabbā.
atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ, hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ
asuci pūtilomo'si, duggandho v'āsi sūkara, sace yujjhitu'kāmo'si, jayaṃ samma dadāmi te'ti.
atrāssudaṃ, sāriputta, bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti, yo koci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati, yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsanti.
so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, tam'eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā patanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

56119.commentary: (THIa) atha vā salomagandhikan'ti meṇḍakalomehi samānagandhaṃ. eḷakalomagandhan'ti'pi vadanti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
vāsito'va surabhī karaṇḍako, pupphapūra mama uttam'aṅgajo, taṃ jarāy'atha salomagandhikaṃ, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
ek'ekalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, ek'ekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
ahañ'c'eva kho pana sabbaso ajaddhukaṃ paṭijāneyyaṃ, imā ca me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāreyyuṃ, tāya c'āhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ, taṃ mam'assa musā'ti.
sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso'ti te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjanti.
s'āssa māluvālatā taruṇā mudukā lomasā vilambinī, sā taṃ sālaṃ upaniseveyya.

56124.meaning1: with fine hair; with fine down

56126.commentary: (MNa) lomasak'aṅgiyo'ti aṅgathero kira nām'esa, kāyassa pana īsakalomasākāratāya lomasak'aṅgiyo'ti pākaṭo jāto.
56126.notes: Theragāthā verse 27 (TH1.27, TH27) is attributed to him.

examples.text: atha kho candano devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yen'āyasmā lomasak'aṅgiyo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā lomasak'aṅgiyo thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

56128.meaningLit: discourse with Lomasakaṅgiya on an auspicious single night

56130.commentary: (MNa) lomasak'aṅgiyo'ti aṅgathero kira nām'esa, kāyassa pana īsakalomasākāratāya lomasak'aṅgiyo'ti pākaṭo jāto.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko āyasmantaṃ lomasakaṃbhiyaṃ etadavoca, so eva nu kho, bhante, sekho vihāro so tathāgatavihāro, udāhu añño'va sekho vihāro añño tathāgatavihāro'ti?

56132.commentary: (MNa) lomasak'aṅgiyo'ti aṅgathero kira nām'esa, kāyassa pana īsakalomasākāratāya lomasak'aṅgiyo'ti pākaṭo jāto.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā lomasavaṅg'iso sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodh'ārāme.

56134.meaning1: pierced by a stroke as deep as the hair

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhadro ass'ājānīyo na h'eva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, api ca kho lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim'ass'āhaṃ paṭikaromī'ti!

56135.meaning1: with hair standing on end; with bristling hair
56135.meaning2: having hair standing on the end

examples.text: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama!

56136.meaning1: with hair standing on end; with bristling hair
56136.meaning2: having hair standing on the end
56136.commentary: (MNa) lomahaṭṭhajātan'ti jātalomahaṃsaṃ, kañcanabhittiyaṃ ṭhapitamaṇināgadantehi viya uddhaggehi lomehi ākiṇṇasarīran'ti attho. lomahaṃso ca nām'esa somanassena'pi hoti domanassena'pi

examples.text: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama!
atha kho rāhu asur'indo candimaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena vepacitti asur'indo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

56137.meaning1: goosebumps; hair standing on end; terror

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo samādhimhā cāvetu'kāmo yena uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami
devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.

56138.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
56138.commentary: (MNa) satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso ucc'aṅgamāyo'ti ime pañca janā.

examples.text: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.

56140.meaning1: hair-raising; causing the hair to stand on end

examples.text: api hi me, bhante, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā lomāni haṭṭhāni. konāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, nāgasamāla, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ lomahaṃsanapariyāyo tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti.
tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ, satthāni nikkhipitvāna, māṇavā etadabravuṃ.
kummaggaṃ paṭipannamhā, bhiṃsanaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ, purato dissati maggo, pacchato ca na dissati.
tadā'si yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadā'si lomahaṃsanaṃ, sabb'ākāra-var'ūpete, sambuddhe parinibbute'ti.
api hi me, bhante, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā lomāni haṭṭhāni. konāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, nāgasamāla, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ lomahaṃsanapariyāyo tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti.
bhāsitam'p'etaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā dev'ātidevena lomahaṃsanapariyāye

56144.meaning1: mastering one's terror; overcoming fear; fearless
56144.commentary: (DNa) lomahaṃsābhisambhuno'ti lomahaṃsaṃ abhibhavitvā ṭhitā, nibbhayā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: puthūsīhā'va sallīnā, lomahaṃs'ābhisambhuno, odātamanasā suddhā, vippasanna'm'anāvilā.

56145.meaning2: submits; complies; to let one's hair drop (as a sign of subduedness or modesty)
56145.commentary: (MNa) na lomaṃ pātetī'ti anulomavatte na vattati, vilomam'eva gaṇhāti.

examples.text: na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.
seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
cakkhūhi n'eva lola-assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca n'ānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.
ath'eko lolamakkaṭo rukkhā otaritvā tassa piṭṭhiṃ abhiruhitvā uccārapassāvaṃ katvā siṅge gaṇhitvā olambanto naṅguṭṭhe gahetvā dolāyanto'va kīḷi
tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti. yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.

56152.meaning1: abandoned agitation; dispelled restlessness; (or) given up longing

examples.text: patirūpako mattikākuṇḍalo'va, loha-aḍḍhamāso'va suvaṇṇachanno, caranti loke parivārachannā, anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā'ti.
rajataṃ nāma kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.

atha kho so habyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati. seyyathā'pi nāma loho divasaṃsantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati, evam'eva so habyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.

56163.commentary: (VINa) lohakumbhī nāma kāḷalohena vā tambalohena vā yena kenaci lohena katā kumbhī.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya. so tattha pheṇ'uddehakaṃ paccati.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco pāpabhikkhu yāni tāni saṅghassa garubhaṇḍāni garuparikkhārāni, seyyath'idaṃ, ārāmo ārāmavatthu vihāro vihāravatthu mañco pīṭhaṃ bhisi bimbohanaṃ lohakumbhī lohabhāṇakaṃ lohavārako lohakaṭāhaṃ vāsī parasu kuṭhārī kudālo… tehi gihīṃ saṅgaṇhā'ti upalāpeti.

56164.commentary: (DHPa) mā lohaguḷan'ti sativossaggalakkhaṇena hi pamādena pamattā niraye tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ gilanti, tena taṃ vadāmi mā pamatto hutvā lohaguḷaṃ gili, mā niraye ḍayhamāno dukkham'idan'ti kandī'ti attho.

examples.text: jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā tattena ayosaṅkunā mukhaṃ vivaritvā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ mukhe pakkhipanti ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ.

56166.meaning1: half a copper coin; half a copper māsaka

examples.text: patirūpako mattikākuṇḍalo'va, loh'aḍḍhamāso'va suvaṇṇachanno, caranti loke parivārachannā, anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā'ti.

56167.meaning2: who sheds the blood (of a Buddha)

examples.text: pattaleso nāma lohapattadharo diṭṭho hoti… sāṭakapattadharo diṭṭho hoti… sumbhakapattadharo diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto. aññaṃ sumbhakapattadharaṃ passitvā codeti, sumbhakapattadharo mayā diṭṭho.

ekaṃ suvaṇṇapātiṃ katvā aññā dve tisso lohapātiyo suvaṇṇavaṇṇe karoti, tato janapadaṃ gantvā kiñci'd'eva aḍḍhaṃ kulaṃ pavisitvā, suvaṇṇabhājanāni kiṇathāti vatvā agghe pucchite samagghataraṃ dātu'kāmā honti.

56171.meaning2: name of the palatial chapter house in Anurādhapura, which was covered with copper tiles

56174.meaning1: big copper jar; large metal pot
56174.commentary: (VINa) lohakumbhī nāma kāḷalohena vā tambalohena vā yena kenaci lohena katā kumbhī. lohabhāṇak'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha pana bhāṇakan'ti arañjaro vuccati.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco pāpabhikkhu yāni tāni saṅghassa garubhaṇḍāni garuparikkhārāni, seyyath'idaṃ… lohakumbhī lohabhāṇakaṃ… tehi gihīṃ saṅgaṇhāti upalāpeti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho mahācoro santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
rajataṃ nāma kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.
daḷhadhanu nāma dvisahassathāmaṃ vuccati, dvisahassathāmaṃ nāma yassa āropitassa jiyābaddho lohasīs'ādīnaṃ bhāro daṇḍe gahetvā yāva kaṇḍappamāṇā ukkhittassa pathavito muccati.

56179.commentary: (VSa) lohavārako pana kāḷaloha-tambaloha-vaṭṭaloha-kaṃsalohānaṃ yena kenaci kato sīhaḷadīpe pādagaṇhanako bhājetabbo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco pāpabhikkhu yāni tāni saṅghassa garubhaṇḍāni garuparikkhārāni, seyyath'idaṃ… lohakumbhī lohabhāṇakaṃ lohavārako lohakaṭāhaṃ… tehi gihīṃ saṅgaṇhāti upalāpeti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho mahācoro santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
tena kho pana samayena lohicco brāhmaṇo sālavatikaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ, brahmadeyyaṃ.

yathā ca bhavaṃ kaccāno makkarakate upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati, evam'eva lohiccakulaṃ upasaṅkamatu. tattha ye māṇavakā vā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ kaccānaṃ abhivādessanti paccuṭṭhissanti āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.

56183.meaning1: engaging in discussion with the Brahman Lohicca

examples.text: atthi imasmiṃ kāye… pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu.

pūraṇena, bhante, kassapena chaḷabhijātiyo paññattā, kaṇh'ābhijāti paññattā, nīl'ābhijāti paññattā, lohit'ābhijāti paññattā, halidd'ābhijāti paññattā, sukk'ābhijāti paññattā, paramasukk'ābhijāti paññattā.
yathā, mahārāja, rañño bhaṇḍ'āgāriko bhaṇḍ'āgāraṃ pavisitvā nīlapītalohit'odātamañjiṭṭhāni rājabhogāni rūpāni passitvā sañjānāti. evaṃ kho, mahārāja, sañjānanalakkhaṇā saññā'ti
atha puriso āgaccheyya lohitapakkhandiko. tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, idaṃ dadhiṃ ca madhuṃ ca sappiṃ ca phāṇitañ'ca ekajjhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, sace ākaṅkhasi piva.
seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, jacc'andho puriso, so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni
kīdiso, bho purisa, kiṃsuko'ti? so evaṃ vadeyya, lohitako kho, ambho purisa, kiṃsuko, seyyathā'pi maṃsapesī'ti.

56190.meaning2: name of one of the group of six monks
